heading: Tata Sons listing is the real flashpoint, not Chandrasekaran’s reappointment, says Harish Salve: Report
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Senior advocate Harish Salve, advisor to N Chandrasekaran, said the Tata Trusts-Tata Sons dispute has shifted from concerns over listing to the chairman’s reappointment. He questioned the RBI’s listing directive and warned it could affect Tata Sons’ governance and oversight.
